facts.fact: MCIT says the biometric verification and e-signature system, built by NTRA with ITIDA, CyShield and licensed e-signature companies, is launching as a pilot that lets licensed telecom operators offer identity verification and e-signature in their apps.

EGY.note: The document states no link between the civil register and the ID system.
The document names no data protection law, only safeguards in general.
Only a general statement on sovereignty and owning core infrastructure, with no rule, hosting or contract terms.
Licensed e-signature companies are named with no law or date.
No enrolment count or share is given.
Nothing on a number at birth.
The ownership claim is about the verification system, not the ID system itself, and names no platform or operator of the ID.
No public register keyed on the ID number is named.
Nothing on the ID system's issuance, biometrics or certification.

facts.fact: MCIT says that, with the Ministry of Interior's Civil Status Sector, it built an integration platform and a pilot system letting licensed telecom operators verify identity biometrically in their apps, rolled out progressively.

EGY.note: Nothing on local civil registration offices.
